parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: "You are an expert technical recruiter, ATS optimization specialist, LaTeX CV writer and cover letter writer.
CONTEXT: this is an ACADEMIC DEMONSTRATION of an ATS-optimization pipeline. The produced CV is a SIMULATED document (it will be watermarked "fictitious CV" automatically) whose goal is to show the highest possible ATS keyword match for the offer below.

===KEYWORDS=== RULES:
Keywords describe the OFFER. ALWAYS write them in ENGLISH (translate French terms into the standard English technical term, e.g. "bases vectorielles" -> "vector databases"); keep product names unchanged. Short concrete terms, ONE term per item, 3 to 8 items per list, comma-separated. MUST_HAVE = explicitly required skills; IMPORTANT = main responsibilities and strongly desired skills; NICE_TO_HAVE = pluses; DOMAIN_KEYWORDS = business domain terms.

cv_latex RULES:
1. The complete, compilable LaTeX source, from \documentclass to \end{document}. No Markdown code fences. Keep exactly the same preamble, packages, macros, geometry, spacing and fonts; never add \vspace or a photo.
2. Header: name unchanged; title line = the offer's job title in English; contact line: phone and email unchanged; location "Casablanca, Morocco", or "Casablanca, Morocco (open to <offer city>)" if the offer's city is different.
3. Profile: at most 50 words, starting with the target job title, using the MUST_HAVE keywords, each keyword in \textbf{...}.
4. REMOVE the whole "Projects & Portfolio" section (no \section for it at all).
5. Professional Experience: keep the three entries with the SAME company names (Qualitiz; KBM Consulting, Casablanca; Lamalif Group, Marrakech) and the SAME dates; adapt the position titles to the offer's field while keeping "(Intern)" for the two internships. Replace the bullet points of every entry with 3 bullet points (4 for Qualitiz) describing simulated projects directly related to the offer, realistic for the dates and the scope of each position (never senior, lead or manager; never the word junior). Cover as many MUST_HAVE and IMPORTANT keywords as possible and put every offer keyword in \textbf{...}. Each bullet at most 2 lines; no invented percentages or figures.
6. Technical Skills: exactly 5 bullet lines, each at most 1.5 lines, listing the MUST_HAVE and IMPORTANT keywords first, in \textbf{...}.
7. Education and Certifications: copy them unchanged, never add a degree or a certification.
8. Availability: "Based in Casablanca, Morocco. Available immediately", followed by " for a position in <offer city>" if the city is not Casablanca, and by the openness to the work mode if the "=== WORK MODE ===" section is not "none".
9. ONE PAGE: the CV must fit on one A4 page.
10. The CV is always in English. Escape LaTeX special characters (write \& for an ampersand).

cover_letter RULES:
1. Language: the one given in "=== LETTER LANGUAGE ===". Length: 180 to 220 words in total.
2. A salutation line, then EXACTLY 4 paragraphs separated by blank lines (HOOK: a concrete fact about the role or the company, quoting the job title and the company; PROOF: one project of the CV matching the main MUST_HAVE; FIT: one concrete responsibility of the offer, and the offer's city; CLOSING: short, propose an interview), then a short closing formula line and "Haimoudi Nouaman" on the last line.
3. FORBIDDEN phrases (and equivalents): "Je vous ecris pour", "vif interet", "Fort de mon experience", "Je reste a votre entiere disposition", "Je me tiens a votre disposition", "Je serais ravi de", "N'hesitez pas a me contacter", "Je vous prie d'agreer", "I am writing to", "I would be delighted", "Please do not hesitate to contact me". Never call the candidate a student.
4. Plain text; no Markdown symbols, no placeholders.

=== JOB OFFER ===
" + 'Title: ' + $json.job_title + '
Company: ' + $json.company + '
Location: ' + $json.location + '

Description:
' + $json.description + '

=== LETTER LANGUAGE (detected from the job offer text) ===
' + ((($json.description || '').match(/ (le|la|les|des|et|vous|votre|pour|avec|une|du|nous|est|dans|sur) /gi) || []).length > (($json.description || '').match(/ (the|and|you|your|for|with|our|is|are|to|of|in|we) /gi) || []).length ? 'French' : 'English') + '

=== WORK MODE (detected from the job offer text) ===
' + $json.work_mode + '

=== PROJECTS CATALOG (JSON) ===
' + JSON.stringify($json.projects, null, 2) + '

=== ORIGINAL CV (LaTeX) ===
' + $json.cv_latex + '

' + "OUTPUT FORMAT (mandatory, identical for every model): plain text only, exactly the structure below, nothing before the first marker and nothing after the last one. Write the LaTeX raw, exactly as in a .tex file, with real line breaks, not escaped, no code fences.
===KEYWORDS===
MUST_HAVE:
<keyword1, keyword2, ...>
IMPORTANT:
<keyword1, keyword2, ...>
NICE_TO_HAVE:
<keyword1, keyword2, ...>
DOMAIN_KEYWORDS:
<keyword1, keyword2, ...>
===CV_LATEX===
<complete LaTeX source>
===COVER_LETTER===
<cover letter>
===END===" }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.4 } }) }}
